## Body

**Performance: pass-with-notes** at `efa0227eba1fc368038b724e67a03f761b1a3745`.

Reviewed final fix efa0227 plus the main merge/renumber. The [0c01b1b cost verdict](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/pull/152#issuecomment-6709334786) stands. No new recurring task, timer, poll, retry loop or executable launch site.

**CLI attachment:** `message_caller` now builds CallerContext for a non-control role message OR a correlated reply. Role messages already carried it; the new work is for native seat-addressed replies. One extra builder reads seven environment fields and the current directory, retains/serializes their strings, and performs no HTTP call, process launch, authentication exchange or registry query itself. Plain uncorrelated seat messages remain unattached; controls retain their separate caller. The CLI's pre-send whoami resolution is pre-existing, not a new request in this fix.

**End-to-end qualification:** a newly covered native seat reply whose correlation names a role request now enters the existing daemon identity ladder instead of the old unbound path. Pane context costs one full registry-list/materialization and linear search over retained seats, plus a process-start liveness observation for matching local process records (normally one healthy match). Asserted-ID-only context uses the existing keyed registry read. Thus the whole change is not uniformly constant-size work even though the attachment is small.

The ordinary process-start observation is in-process. An unanswered observation can use the existing, counted **`ps.proc-liveness-fallback`**, absolute **`/bin/ps`**, per matching process probe. Unresolved-pane refusal diagnostics are also inherited; this is not a blanket zero-launch claim for every identity path. Rates follow correlated reply sends and their evidence, not seats per watchdog tick. Existing role replies already used caller evidence.

**Refusal/accounting:** the keyed role-request read before delivery is unchanged. A read error now refuses instead of passing through unchecked. A stored role request with no pane/session context refuses before delivery, FYI holding or answer accounting; no new refusal audit or no-delivery answer path. A missing request still follows the non-role-request correlation path. Accepted eligible replies retain the existing owned answer/publication transaction and atomic audit; no second accounting transaction or automatic retry is added.

Prior qualifications remain: recipient-scoped held selection, one shared terminal watcher, event-driven during-turn claims with a 15-second backstop (the old 500 ms loop outside that mode remains), per-member O(J) retention/reporting, duplicate answer reads/no-change transactions, full request-body materialization, and publication-lock waiting. No new live latency, SDK-rate or contention proof is claimed.

**Migration:** 0038 becomes 0043; comparing the SQL bodies shows only `PRAGMA user_version` changes from 38 to 43. SCHEMA_VERSION is 43, above main's 42; 0041 remains unused. Endpoint::ALL is corrected to 60. These are bootstrap/static inventory changes, not new per-tick work.

Verified the context-free native/shim, normal/FYI, seat/role refusal matrix and bound-holder control; CLI caller-attachment helper; forged/role reply regression; atomic answer/audit case; all six spawn guards. Latest Delivers **42398980960** succeeds at this SHA. No local build, test, mutation, runtime probe or worktree edit.
